svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Kuration operators
svg.desc: Seven gameplay operators shipped in kuration.gameplay: join_video pairs an action log with a video frame by frame; pixel_shift measures how far a picture moves on screen per isolated keypress via Farneback optical flow; action_state_consistency issues a per-clip verdict of consistent, inconsistent, or inconclusive against a baseline; collision detects and classifies wall-hits (head_on, angled, slides); slam_pipeline recovers a camera's 3D path from raw video with loop closure; slam_quality scores each window's reconstruction for gaps, impossible motion, and scale; slam_motion_diversity bins windows by path length, turning, and climb.
svg.text: curate large gameplay datasets for training world models
